verdict.rationale: Zoho Books lists Invoicing and Online Payments as core product areas. Vendor copy says users can create invoices and track payments, including via MCP-connected agents, and send bulk collection reminders. The invoicing and payments evidence is mostly feature headings, with no detail on sending invoices to customers, embedding payment links, or showing a viewed status. Missing for 10: documentation of emailing or sending invoices, online payment links or gateways on invoices, invoice viewed-status tracking, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
